method: Actual engine fixtures, not a full campaign playthrough

rows.name: five debuts in consecutive chapters 2–6; none in chapter one
actual pursuit schedules exactly one encounter and no legacy parade
left and right attacks hit their painted lane; vertical dodge escapes
real damage, one contact per swing, successful pulse repels only once
ground encounters use actual board health and preserve player ship health
pause and save restore retain the exact encounter
safe rehearsal retains the titan without awarding cards or repeated contact counts
final two live waves contain 32 and 24 ships; no square grid
in-flight old final wave retains credited kills without extra score
dog legs move with effects off and retain four articulated feet
introductory deck routes its original robodog through the running rig
painting and explosion rendering never mutate gameplay state
